Hemoglobin is printed with the unit mg/dl in Table 2; the unit is kept as printed and not corrected.
The discussion says the MRI showed no enhancing retrocochlear mass lesion and the Figure 4 caption says MRI without contrast; the source does not state whether contrast was given for that MRI.

The ankle CT reported as osteoarthritis and the absent referral letter appear in the chart-review paragraph about the outside-facility visit 11 years before the index presentation, but their own sentences state no time and "At that time (11 years ago)" scopes only the ankle-pain and laboratory sentence.
The rheumatoid factor result before referral (positive, no value) and the rheumatology clinic Table 2 value (44 IU/mL) are separate statements; the source does not say they are the same measurement.
